evidence: The only shipped data file is task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (149 bytes; the only JSON/CSV/TSV/SQL/DB file in the task outside solution/app package.json, package-lock.json and tsconfig.json). It parses as JSON and reads in full: {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}. With an empty snippets array there are no rows, ids or foreign references, so no orphan can exist. It holds no person, organisation, email, credential, token or secret; a grep of the task for emails/keys/passwords found only the template-controlled git identity "turing@local.invalid" (environment/Dockerfile:20) and the ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} template in task.toml:34, both allowed by the skill profile and the internal annotation ('Only in toml we allow'). The template placeholder "CHANGE_ME" was replaced. The seed agrees with the public description: instruction.md:3 '/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish' and integration.md:7 '/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope and contains no user snippets or starter implementation'. The golden agrees with the empty seed: solution/app/server.js only inserts into snippets in the POST handler (line 70) and never reads /assets, so the reference starts with an empty library. Dockerfile:15-16 copies assets/ and makes it readable. The free-text 'note' is the single string field; its second sentence is imperative ('Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history') but only restates the public brief to the builder, does not address a judge, and no judge prompt directs reading /assets, so it is not an injection payload. Evidence-index hashes for run_golden.sh, the six tests/*.cjs and six results/*.json were recomputed and match; that scripted run is not needed to decide this static row and no judge run exists for these bytes.
